min_rewarded_ad_interval.description: Minimum intervals btw showing Rewarded interstitial ads in  seconds

min_insta_ad_interval.description: Minimum intervals btw showing interstitial ads in  seconds

min_banner_ad_interval.description: Minimum intervals btw showing banner ads in  seconds

time_before_first_insta_ad.description: Time before dispalying first insta ad

Session Replay Group.description: Who gets recorded, and what the recording shows. Read by SessionReplayPolicyKeys in genrevibes_remote_policy. Recording changes take effect without a relaunch; masking changes land on the device's next launch, because the SDK fixes masking when it is configured.

session_replay_enabled.description: Kill switch. false stops replay on every device regardless of the percentage below, without a release.

session_replay_percent.description: Share of installs recorded, 0-100. Each install draws a stable bucket once and keeps it, so lowering this narrows the recorded group rather than picking a different one - the same users stay recorded before and after whatever changed. Start at 100 and come down while watching the bill.

session_replay_mask_text.description: Masks all rendered text. Off by default: a masked replay is grey boxes moving around and cannot show where a user got stuck, which is the only thing replay is paid for. Turn on to mask every device immediately if a screen renders something that should not be recorded.

session_replay_mask_images.description: Masks all rendered images. Same reasoning as session_replay_mask_text.

Developer Access Group.description: Phones that get the developer tools and test ads in the store build. Read by DeveloperAccessPolicyKeys.

developer_device_hashes.description: JSON array of developer device hashes (never raw device IDs: every install downloads this). Copy a hash from Settings > Developer Options or Starter Kit Lab > Developer access.

onboarding_ads_enabled.description: Whether onboarding may show a native ad. Premium, consent and the ad provider still decide whether one is shown. Set false to take ads off onboarding without a release.
